item.title: Iran-Azerbaijan trade grows despite war: Minister
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Trade between Iran and the Republic of Azerbaijan increased over the past six months despite the challenges posed by the US-Israeli war on Iran, Minister of Roads and Urban Development Farzaneh Sadeq has said, stressing the need to expand infrastructure and remove obstacles to sustain the growth.

item.title: Araghchi: International community must hold US and Israeli regime accountable for their illegal actions
item.description: New York, IRNA – The Foreign Minister of the Islamic Republic of Iran attributed the prevailing insecurity in the Persian Gulf and the Strait of Hormuz to the interventionist and illegal actions of the United States and the Zionist regime, saying that the international community must hold them accountable for all the resulting humanitarian, security, and economic consequences.

item.title: Iraq to resume Iran flights from Najaf airport within 24 hours
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iraq will resume direct flights to Iran from Najaf International Airport within 24 hours, Iraq’s ambassador to Tehran Yasser al-Hajjaj said on Monday, adding that Baghdad had not ordered a halt to air services between the two neighboring countries.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86277438/Iraq-to-resume-Iran-flights-from-Najaf-airport-within-24-hours

Tehran, IRNA – Iraq will resume direct flights to Iran from Najaf International Airport within 24 hours, Iraq’s ambassador to Tehran Yasser al-Hajjaj said on Monday, adding that Baghdad had not ordered a halt to air services between the two neighboring countries.
